_comment: Row map for the Accel-KKR CFO Chronograph template for Yes Energy (assets/chronograph_template.xlsx). Every labelled row of the sheet is listed here as '<Section> | <Label>' and says where its monthly values come from. Sources: pl / bs / cf = the Finance view lines (a name is read at the deepest COA or cash-flow level it exists), arr / customers = ARR_ANALYTICS bridge categories, bookings / pipeline = GTM_ANALYTICS metrics, arr_rate = a ratio of two ARR_ANALYTICS LTM amounts (derived, labelled), customer_rate = a ratio of ARR_ANALYTICS CUSTOMER_BRIDGE LTM counts (derived, labelled), revolver = one METRIC of FINANCE_ANALYTICS REVOLVER (Finance-maintained; a stored 0 is written as 0, a missing month is refused), 'limit_checks' refuse a month where one row exceeds another, 'level' pins a line to one COA level and a list of lines takes them all, 'negate' writes the row with the view's sign reversed, because the template enters costs, outflows, churn, downsell and lost customers as positive amounts and subtracts them in its formulas (the build's calculations and gates use the view's sign), 'blank_if_all_zero' leaves a metric blank when the view returns 0 in every month, null = no view carries it (the row is left blank, never 0). 'remainder_of' fills a group's Other row with the line total less the rows named. 'formula' rows keep the template's own formula, copied to every month. 'chain' rows take the first month from the source and keep the template's link to the prior month after it. The build refuses any labelled row that is not listed, and any template whose hash differs from template_sha256.

display._comment: Amounts are held in USD thousands: the build divides every amount it writes by 1,000 and the formulas calculate in thousands; the gates multiply back and compare in dollars. Counts (Customer Bridge, Headcount), percentages and ratios are not divided.

checks.explain: total assets less total liabilities and equity must be 0 in every month (the FINANCE_ANALYTICS balance sheet balances)
cash-flow Net Income vs P&L Net Income: they should agree; any difference is reported for review

checks.row: Cash Flow Statement | Cash Before Financing
checks.explain: the sheet's Cash from Operations plus Cash from Investing must equal the view's Cash before Financing
the sheet's NDR includes FX (carried in the Transactional downsell row), so it is checked against the view's Net Dollar Retention + FX

limit_checks.explain: Drawn Revolver must not exceed Revolver Size in any month
